text: MAAP was founded in Melbourne in 2014 by Jarrad Smith and Oliver Cousins; co-founder Oliver Cousins told Cycling Weekly in 2025 that MAAP is a private company with no one else to answer to and no venture capital.
short: MAAP was founded by Jarrad Smith and Oliver Cousins in 2014 and is a private company with no venture capital.

source.name: Lamont Magazine: MAAP, breaking away from the pack
source.quote: Founded in 2014 by keen cyclists and long time friends, Oliver Cousins and Jarrad Smith

additionalSources.name: Cycling Weekly: 'We're not just trying to build a cycling brand, we want to build a global brand' — meeting MAAP's founders
additionalSources.quote: We’re a private company, so we’ve got no one else to answer to, there’s no stock price, there’s no minimum growth or venture capital
